title: Webflow
excerpt: Webflow sites for marketing teams that want visual control and a CMS that matches the design.

seo.title: Webflow | Mohit Walia
seo.description: Webflow sites for marketing teams that want visual control and a CMS that matches the design.

hero.heading: Webflow sites that stay editable after launch.
hero.subtitle: Marketing pages, CMS collections, and interactions, structured so a designer or marketer can publish without breaking the layout.

overview: Webflow fits marketing sites and content-led brands. I set up the layout system, the CMS, and the interactions so the site looks considered and the team can add pages later.
problem: A Webflow project becomes a stack of one-off sections. The next landing page takes as long as the first because nothing was built to be reused.
solution: I build a small system of classes, components, and CMS templates first, then the pages. New campaigns reuse that system.

features.title: Reusable components
features.detail: Nav, sections, and cards are components, not copies.

features.title: CMS that matches the design
features.detail: Collections have the fields the templates actually use.

features.title: Interactions with restraint
features.detail: Motion supports the page. It does not delay it.

process.title: Discovery
process.detail: We pin down the outcome, the constraints, and what the first release has to do.

process.title: Planning
process.detail: I turn that into a scope, a sequence, and the technical approach.

process.title: Development
process.detail: I build in small slices you can review, on the stack this service uses.

process.title: Testing
process.detail: We check the flows that matter before anything is treated as finished.

process.title: Launch
process.detail: I ship it, watch the first days, and leave you with a clear way to change it.

benefits.title: Marketing can publish
benefits.detail: New posts and landing pages use templates that already fit.

benefits.title: The file stays tidy
benefits.detail: Classes have names. The project is not a mystery.

benefits.title: A path to custom code later
benefits.detail: If a feature outgrows Webflow, we can move that part without throwing the site away.

timeline.detail: Type, color, and the components pages will share.
The marketing pages and CMS templates.

faqs.question: Can you take over an existing Webflow project?
faqs.answer: Yes. I clean the class list only where it blocks the work you asked for.

faqs.question: Do forms go to email?
faqs.answer: Webflow forms can notify your inbox. If you need them in another tool, that connection is part of the scope.
